notes.title: New update coming
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we hope you are well

2020 was not an easy year, we had many plans for the game but with everything that happened it was not possible to develop the game.
We had a lot of setbacks, but now that things are working out we came back with everything to continue and end the game.
The game will complete 3 years of early access on 2021-03-08!
This is far above what we had in mind when we launched it, but since the launch we have experienced several problems, such as incompatibility in the old engine, switching engines, changing the game art from 2D to 3D and much more!

We are an indie team of just 2 people and the amount of things to do in the game plus the limited time to work on the game (we don’t just work with games, we haven’t reached that goal yet) it became impossible to continue to develop the game and release updates regularly.

But finally we are managing to develop the game regularly and a new update will be available in February. The update will be released only in February as we want all the features that were already present in previous versions to continue to work.

The main changes will be in the 3D models we are going to use. We went back to lowpoly because it is the type of 3D that we are able to offer with such a small team.

This new version will have:
 New Island
 New player
 Cooperative mode
 Build shelter
 Build fireplace
 Build torch
 Build chest to store items
 Build axe
 Build pickaxe


The sword and snakes will be removed from the game as several bugs have already been reported by you. Achievements for sword and snakes will also be removed from the game. Perhaps we will add it again in the future.

notes.title: WE ARE BACK - EA v0.1.0 (again)
notes.content:
Hello everyone
After a long long long time we are back!
We have so many issues that we need make the game from start two times. Now the game are in 3D, using Unity, all models done by us, we know that are not pretty models but are original.
In this first version we just make the base of game, you can:

Cut trees
Walk and run
Craft a fireplace and a shelter
Can eat if have an apple in the inventory
Can drink water
Rest on the shelter


Removed:
All achievements are removed for now, we will put in future version again


As said before, we just make the base of game, but we release because the last time we release an update to you was almost one year ago.

Known Issues:
[strike]On Linux the camera stay stucked on the ground.[/strike] - Just keep your system updated!


We hope you enjoy these changes, and if you have suggestions or find bugs, be sure to let us know.

Player making the move to cut the trees
Axe in hand (when you have one) while cutting the trees


Changed:

New format of the island (now no longer a huge rectangle)
Bar of tired replaced by hungry bar
Home screen and pause menu screen have new buttons
Dusk and dawn gradually
Visual effect of the fire light
Eating an apple raises the hungry bar
Fire will end if the life reduce to 0
You can add leaves, branchs and wood to the fire to keep it lit
Now appears the name of the item that will be picked up from the floor in the hint
The player's life will recover automatically when the water and hungry bar is nearly full
Recover stamina while sleep
Now it is harder to cut the trees with just the hand


Fixed:

When loading a game and returning to the main menu was an infinitely loading screen


Known Issues:

In Linux sometimes the game does not get completely fullscreen, if moving to another application and returning to the game is correct. We are trying to solve this as soon as possible.


We hope you like these changes and if you have suggestions or find bugs do not forget to let us know
